data.body: **[P2] Remove timed-out barriers from the lane queue.** Setting `canceled` leaves the marker queued while an exporter is blocked, so every subsequent warm invocation adds another `_FlushBarrier` and `Event` despite the pending-record cap. This can grow memory without bound and makes checkpoint-path queue scans progressively slower. Retain each barrier's lane and remove the marker under that lane's condition on timeout, or coalesce outstanding flush barriers; add a repeated-timeout test that keeps the exporter blocked.
